title: Inference providers serve models themselves

Case Studies
AGGREGATOR
Clustering — GPU servers and networking
Serving engines — built and run on vLLM, SGLang and more
Inference optimization — batching, concurrency, max GPU/VRAM use
Load balancing — spreading requests
API connection — linking real services to inference servers
Scaling and monitoring — load, outages, performance
They do all this for you
